gbm_population_evidence.quote: Have histologically confirmed WHO grade IV GBM or its variants.
Participants with WHO grade III recurrent malignant glioma will be allowed to enroll to Cohort 1 only.

candidate_evidence.quote: This study is looking at the safety and efficacy of the drug combination of ASP8374 with cemiplimab in people with recurrent malignant glioma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Be at first or second relapse.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: CD8+ TIL density from tumors obtained from participants randomized to the neoadjuvant study arm (2A) will be compared to tumor CD8+ TIL density obtained from control participants enrolled on Arm 2B who do not receive neoadjuvant therapy.

role_evidence.quote: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has not approved ASP8374 as a treatment for any disease.
This study is looking at the safety and efficacy of the drug combination of ASP8374 with cemiplimab in people with recurrent malignant glioma.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational anti-TIGIT monoclonal antibody (development code ASP8374)

role_evidence.quote: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has not approved cemiplimab for recurrent malignant glioma but it has been approved for other uses.

source_quote.quote: CD8+ TIL density from tumors obtained from participants randomized to the neoadjuvant study arm (2A) will be compared to tumor CD8+ TIL density obtained from control participants enrolled on Arm 2B who do not receive neoadjuvant therapy.

coder_notes: Glioblastoma named in conditions/inclusion; WHO grade III malignant glioma allowed in Cohort 1 only, so mixed_glioma_gbm_named. cns5_terminology historical: 'WHO grade IV GBM or its variants' with no IDH requirement, and GBM arising from prior low-grade glioma (secondary GBM) is allowed. Both ASP8374 and cemiplimab are investigational here (both experimental_combination). Within the EXPERIMENTAL Cohort 2 arm, Group 2B (no neoadjuvant checkpoint therapy before surgery) serves as the control for the CD8+ TIL primary endpoint, hence control_arm_from_other_arms yes. CD8+ TIL density is an immune pharmacodynamic tumour marker (not a molecular selection biomarker); candidate_matched false as it is not a selection biomarker. ASP8374 supply ended Oct 2022; patients could continue cemiplimab alone.
